source.evidence_kind: AArch64 disassembly, relative relocations, read-only function/call index, code-pointer inventory, and committed BFLYT catalogue. No synchronized live capture.

observations: The typeinfo string identifies the six-entry relocated code-pointer sequence as nn::ui2d::LayoutPaneFactory.
Slot 2 is the BFLYT pane-type dispatcher 0x19212e0; slot 4 is 0x1921ed0; slot 5 is 0x19215b0.

No indexed direct B/BL caller reaches 0x19212e0. The address point occurs in the pointer inventory, but this main image has no ADRP+ADD/LDR code reference to its vtable cell or address point. The scan is limited to direct page-relative address materialization patterns; it cannot exclude runtime-filled references or use by another module.

slot4_indirect_candidate.receiver_register: x22, copied from incoming argument x1
slot4_indirect_candidate.receiver_note: The method also traverses the x22 list at +0x20/+0x28 after this call. Static input flow does not establish that x22 has LayoutPaneFactory type or that this slot-2 call resolves to 0x19212e0.

slot19_context_flow.function_argument_x1: Copied unchanged to x20 and forwarded to child slot-19 calls; the function does not dereference/name this argument.
slot19_context_flow.function_argument_x2: Copied to x21 and read at byte offsets +0x1d, +0x1f and float offset +0x18; native field semantics remain unnamed.
slot19_context_flow.recursive_observation: Slot 19 walks pane child links and dispatches child vtable +0x98, preserving x1/x2 and forwarding the normalized update flag. No separate context callback target is resolved inside this method.

slot19_pointer_inventory.observation: The common update target occurs in slot 19 in multiple relocated code-pointer sequences. Four sequences carry recoverable RTTI names; unnamed sequences remain classified only by pointer membership.

raw_resource.compression: Zstandard .zs resource; decoded BFLYT records are represented in the asset catalogue.

resolved_scissor_submission.observation: The SCR1 renderer submits/restores scissor rectangles through NVN SetScissors around generic Pane rendering. Static submission is proven; live context pointer, first index, rectangle count/data, viewport origin, and pixel coverage are not.

remaining_static_boundary.outer_resource_loader: The main-image evidence proves the scr1 type-switch arm, constructor, parser, installed slot-19 method, and catalogued LMyDesignEditCanvas records. It does not identify the resource-loader callsite/object that invokes the LayoutPaneFactory virtual dispatcher or prove which archive instance is active.
remaining_static_boundary.precalc_scheduler: UIMgr::PreCalc callback 0x1dd3e70 is registered by 0x1dd3bd0 and calls RootPage processing, but it has no indexed direct caller; external cadence and order relative to draw events are unresolved.
remaining_static_boundary.runtime_blocker: The raw layout resource and both SCR1 records are present and catalogued. The static evidence does not identify which resource-loader object invokes LayoutPaneFactory at runtime or capture a live rendered frame.
capture_needed: On ACNH 1.0.0, load LMyDesignEditCanvas and capture the archive/layout key, loader call stack, LayoutPaneFactory object address/vptr, and the actual indirect target at 0x1921f20 or equivalent callsite.

At 0x19212e0 record w3 tag and x0-x6; on the scr1 branch record allocated object, source bytes, and returned object pointer; then record the same instance at slot 19 (x0-x3), including children and parent pointers.

For the frame that renders S_Scissor_00/01, capture PreCalc and draw callback timestamps/order, pane flags/transforms, 0x18faf70 x0-x3 arguments, resolved NVN SetScissors rectangle array, logical viewport dimensions, target pixel bounds, framebuffer origin, and a matching GPU/frame capture.

scanner_control.scope: ADRP followed within three instructions by ADD or 64-bit LDR in the executable main segment.
